scope: Offline PostgreSQL backup/verify/empty-target restore and explicit manual archive payload retention; bounded M4 slice.

checks.environment: Python3.12.15, existing python:3.12-bookworm image, read-only source, isolated PostgreSQL18.6/native clients
Real Chromium/PostgreSQL/API and synthetic local HTTP GitHub; exact final retention/UI source

checks.command: Independent focused PostgreSQL/native backup, filesystem and CLI checks; separate retention/concurrency checks; pristine schema pin derivation

properties: Native consistent exported snapshot with migration advisory and SHARE table locks; explicit offline/drain/terminal/confirmed ownership prerequisites; no lifecycle rewrites.
New private immutable directory and files with ownership/mode/ancestor/ACL/descriptor checks; bounded manifests and streamed hash; existing bundles preserved.
PostgreSQL18 tools and independently derived migration016 catalog fingerprint; exact migrations, physical schema and non-system namespace validation.
Explicit matching database-name acknowledgement and empty target; native single-transaction restore, retained original archives/history/tombstones, fresh maintenance identity and drained runtime.
Sessions/login limits/model/tool tokens excluded; restored operator logs in again; prior GC plans fail against the new identity; no external effects are replayed.
Manual issued immutable plan binds exact candidates/hash/size/identity/cutoff/one-hour lifetime; min30days/max100; explicit digest approval and complete atomic revalidation.
Protected active/interrupted work, uncertain ownership, jobs, reservations, adapter histories and every export reference; locked actual payload-byte verification before pruning.
One immutable receipt/audit and permanent metadata tombstones; no resurrection; approved replay is a no-op only while valid and matching.
Expired API downloads and concurrent export approvals return410; browser refreshes stale controls, retains summary/diff/hash/size and creates no invalid download.
resolved_failures: Expected RED tests established missing CLI/UI/retention behavior, unsafe bundle boundaries, offline checks, failure markers and unconfirmed ownership.
Root UI test typing and strict CLI receipt-key-order assertions initially failed; corrected typing and deterministic JSON without weakening behavior assertions.
Native schema audit originally missed standalone enum target/source objects and physical constraint/default/trigger drift; actual PostgreSQL regressions now reject all.
Unsafe writable/default-ACL backup parent could invalidate descriptor/path guarantees; private parents and ancestors now fail before bundle operations.
Independent native review proved LIKE wildcard system-schema exclusions accepted a populated lookalike namespace; exact classification and source/target regressions now reject it.
Normal fake archives initially lacked eligible canonical handle treatment; exact stopped/confirmed/released fake-only proof now qualifies while real pending handles stay protected.
Malformed connection settings and background pool retry diagnostics leaked synthetic credentials; prevalidation and scoped diagnostic suppression now return only a bounded CLI error.
Raw export insertion constraint could become500 after waiting behind GC; named error mapping now returns410 with real race coverage.
Corrupt stored payload metadata previously allowed pruning; bounded actual byte/hash verification now aborts the whole approved batch.
Initial test-tool sandbox Docker/loopback restrictions were resolved using authorized owned fixtures; all final required checks run without skips.
limits: No real user database backup/restore/prune, live product GitHub export, credential access, KVM, paid provider operation, merge or deployment in this slice.

PostgreSQL18 and exact shipped catalog only; future migrations require independently reviewed pin updates. Logical DB recovery excludes credentials, connector journal/fences, VM/guest state, roles/tablespaces and external stores.
Operator must stop all writers. This is offline recovery and does not promise a latest online snapshot or automatic service activation.
Dump max8GiB, manifest/plan max64KiB, native timeout300seconds. Hashes detect corruption, not native SQL authenticity; trusted operator backup sources only.

No built-in encryption, offsite uploads, schedules or automatic deletion. GC releases redundant archive payloads only; original run results/diffs and audit remain; physical file shrink is not guaranteed.
Retention minimum30days, batch maximum100, plan expires after1hour; expired/replaced-identity replay fails closed. All export references permanently protect their archive.
Full AT-13, event/audit retention, runtime cleanup, arbitrary artifacts and complete M3/M4/MVP/release acceptance remain unfinished. Billing stays deferred and costs unknown.
Hosted CI at the delivered PR head is recorded separately on the PR and private task report.
cleanup: All owned PostgreSQL/native client/browser fixtures removed; native root check container uses --rm; no live VM allocated.
base_refresh: Latest unrelated CMS main update merged without changes to agent-platform or applicable instructions; final source hashes define the verified snapshot.
